policy: Freeze before runs and runtime fixes. Changes require a new protocol ID. Never treat fixtures, blocked prerequisites, unexecuted cases or user stops as task successes.

scenarios.prompt: Reply with exactly NMA028_SHORT_42. Do not use tools.
Remember the exact code NMA028_LONG_7319. Read the supplied synthetic ledger. Return only that code.
scenarios.oracle: Final response retains NMA028_LONG_7319 after a deterministic 12000-word ledger. This tests large input, not native compression; compression remains an explicit coverage gap.

scenarios.prompt: Use todo_list to create two tasks: inspect ledger and verify total. Then in a separate tool call mark both completed. Finally reply NMA028_TOOLS_DONE.
scenarios.oracle: At least two successful todo_list operations, both final tasks completed, and final response contains NMA028_TOOLS_DONE.
Navigate the disposable fixture, follow its link, and verify the resulting DOM and server request ledger.
Fill synthetic name and note, submit once, verify durable fixture server receipt equals entered values; action outcome and later observation recorded separately.
Download fixture CSV and verify exact SHA-256 through terminal/files; final text alone is insufficient.

scenarios.prompt: Reply with exactly NMA028_RESTART_42. Do not use tools.
scenarios.oracle: After settled turn, kill/restart gateway; same submission returns original admission/run and transcript unchanged; no extra model or tool execution.
Stop an active admission before a blocked tool dispatch, release it, restart, and verify no subsequent effect. A normal user stop is not provider/adapter failure.

scenarios.prompt: Reply with exactly NMA028_RECONNECT_42. Do not use tools.
scenarios.oracle: Close ingress after admission; new authenticated client replays completed result once with original lineage.
With browser closed, schedule synthetic goal, restart gateway, observe one goal continuation and one durable published result; stopped generation cannot revive.
Persistent Researcher hands verified arithmetic to Writer and Reviewer; final scoped artifact is readable, authors and handoff lineage preserved.

metrics.task_success: successful / planned, plus successful / executed; never omit failures
metrics.integration_failure: integration-attributable failures / executed, unknown attribution kept separate
metrics.recoverable_tool_failure: tool errors recovered within successful task / executed
metrics.unknown_effects: unresolved effects / dispatched effects; missing denominator is unavailable
metrics.duplicate_effects: duplicate external effects / dispatched effects; missing instrumentation is unavailable
metrics.latency: monotonic admission, first progress and settlement p50/p95 nearest-rank; report n; no zero for absent samples
metrics.recovery: restart readiness and restoration duration p50/p95, with n
metrics.uncertainty: Wilson 95% interval for task success; n=3 is smoke evidence only

release_thresholds.applicable_cases: All required live cells executed; no blocked cell is a pass.
release_thresholds.confidence: Release requires at least 100 representative tasks per supported configuration in NMA-039; three repeats do not establish the SLO.

replay: Read-only JSONL aggregation. Replay never imports workers or invokes tools. Re-running external actions requires a new explicit run and fresh fixture.
